say:3:1321005001:1.text: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!

say:3:1321005001:1.male: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!
say:3:1321005001:1.female: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!

say:4:1321005002:1.text: But of course, my work involves far more than just arranging tea sets. The process of preparing and brewing tea is an art in itself.

say:5:1321005003:1.text: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.
say:5:1321005003:1.source_cn: 先是预热，然后投、洗、冲、泡、分茶，每一步都格外关键。
say:5:1321005003:1.male: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.
say:5:1321005003:1.female: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.

say:6:1321005004:1.text: That sounds so complicated... You must be incredibly skilled!
say:6:1321005004:1.source_cn: 哇，听起来好复杂……你一定很专业！

say:7:1321005005:1.text: Thank you for the kind words. Besides tending to the tea, I'm also responsible for keeping the manor immaculate—though the naturally weathered ruins are left as they are. His Lordship has always appreciated the beauty of time's touch.
say:7:1321005005:1.source_cn: 多谢您的夸奖。除去茶具相关的工作，我也要保证庄园内的整...

say:8:1321005006:1.text: Looks like you take on so much work here. You must be pretty busy.
say:8:1321005006:1.source_cn: 你确实负责了庄园内的不少工作呢，平时肯定很忙吧。

say:9:1321005007:2.text: As His Lordship's most trusted creation, I take great pride in dedicating myself to these duties.
say:9:1321005007:2.source_cn: 作为最熟悉子爵先生喜好的造物，自然该多用心。

say:10:1321005008:1.text: After all, I am his favorite teapot—it's my duty to ensure everything is flawless.
say:10:1321005008:1.source_cn: 我陪伴先生多年，又是先生生前最喜爱的茶具。哪里有人比我...

choice_prompt:11:1321005008.text: After all, I am his favorite teapot—it's my duty to ensure everything is flawless.
choice_prompt:11:1321005008.source_cn: 我陪伴先生多年，又是先生生前最喜爱的茶具。哪里有人比我更该为这一切负责呢？

say:12:1321005009:1.text: Oh, absolutely not. It would improper to ask a guest to brew tea. Please leave the rest to me.
say:12:1321005009:1.source_cn: 不，剩下的由我来完成就好。让客人亲自泡茶未免太失礼了。

say:14:1321005012:1.text: Let's head over now! Chippy can't wait to see what his work is like!

say:17:1321005015:1.text: I'll be brewing a good pot of tea shortly.
say:17:1321005015:1.source_cn: 茶水……我待会儿会泡一壶好茶，想请几位贵客品尝一番。

say:18:1321005016:1.text: If it's not too much trouble... would you mind bringing Mister Flower here too?
say:18:1321005016:1.source_cn: 所以，如果方便的话……还请您把奇花叫上。
say:18:1321005016:1.male: If it's not too much trouble... would you mind bringing Mister Flower here too?

say:19:1321005017:1.text: Oh? Mister Teapot, are you trying to make up with him?
say:19:1321005017:1.source_cn: 哦？茶壶先生，这是想和奇花侍者和好的意思吗？

say:20:1321005018:1.text: Ahem, I prefer to think of it as showing some noble courtesy—just like His Lordship would.
say:20:1321005018:1.source_cn: 咳……！我更愿意称之为贵族风度——就像子爵先生那样。

say:21:1321005019:1.text: Anyway, please do come back for some tea later.

choice:11:0:1.text: Do I need to try making tea, too?

say:23:1321005010:1.source_cn: 是的。感谢您答应我的邀约，为我和奇花进行评判。
say:23:1321005010:1.male: That's right. Thank you for taking the time to experience my work.
